note: Fake clock starts at 0. Before each op the clock advances to `at`, firing due timers (earliest first, FIFO on ties) so trailing flushes are recorded at their timer time. `handled` is the boolean returned by handle(). `flushes[].at` is the clock at flush.

traces.name: leading_edge_then_trailing
traces.description: First event flushes synchronously; later events in the window batch until the 60 ms timer.

traces.name: elapsed_exactly_window
traces.description: Leading edge triggers when now - lastFlushAt >= windowMs (boundary at 60).

traces.name: empty_text_swallowed
traces.description: Empty assistant/reasoning text returns handled=true and produces nothing, not even a buffer.

traces.name: non_coalescable_not_handled
traces.description: user_message, error, todo, plugin, compaction are not handled (return false).

traces.name: text_boundaries
traces.description: Concatenate only same kind, same assistant messageId, same provider, same turnId; reasoning ignores messageId.

traces.name: tool_call_merge_by_call_id_in_place
traces.description: Tool entries merge by callId and keep the first slot; text between stays ordered.

traces.name: terminal_tool_flushes_immediately
traces.description: completed/failed/canceled tool status flushes the whole buffer immediately and clears the timer.

traces.name: flush_for_and_discard
traces.description: flushFor flushes and keeps the buffer (lastFlushAt retained); flushAndDiscard also drops it (next event is a leading edge).

traces.name: flush_all_multiple_agents
traces.description: flushAll iterates buffers in creation order.

traces.name: bursty_stream
traces.description: 300 pseudo-random events (seeded) over two agents with tools, reasoning, empty text and errors.
